profile.headline: Software Engineer I
profile.summary: With over six years of experience in engineering and software development, I am a passionate and versatile Application Support Engineer at ClearSky Technologies. I enjoy applying my skills in Linux, SQL, Java, and Python to improve the CI/CD pipelines, software updates, security, and performance of the applications that support the operational excellence goals of Communication Technology Services. I am motivated by the opportunity to work with a diverse and talented team of developers, engineers, and managers, and I am excited about contributing to the innovation and growth of the wireless services industry.

positions.title: DevOps Support Engineer
positions.description: Provided technical support and improve CI/CD pipelines to meet operational excellence goals. Updated package versions and resolve dependency conflicts to keep application software up-to-date and reduce risk. Wrote and executed Python scripting to support and implement changes for development team services. Migrated server infrastructure to more power efficient instance types and released mature capacity. Built and deployed React components for internal web application supporting operational excellence initiatives. Triaged high severity issues, updated ticket correspondence, and lead conference calls during on-call rotation. Updated AWS infrastructure to address and resolve security and vulnerability issues.

positions.title: ICQA Program Developer
positions.description: Managed an internal Ruby on Rails web application supporting fulfillment center operations teams. Built and deployed web application features with Ruby, JavaScript, SQL, and Haml for full stack development. Leveraged Amazon AWS cloud services such as EC2, RDS, and S3 to distribute site access across the fulfillment network. Maintained development and production MySQL servers to support web application functionality. Wrote SQL code to support operations with metric reporting and debug backend database issues. Organized projects and tracked changes on a Linux cloud desktop using Git for version control.

positions.title: Process Engineer
positions.description: Strengthened customer relationships through supply chain continuous improvement events and projects. Created standard work for process improvement: policies, standard operating procedures, and work instructions. Implemented facility HACCP program and developed HACCP manual documentation as HACCP coordinator. Developed QMS documentation, root cause analysis, and corrective actions as interim Quality Manager. Created warehouse layout in CAD Software, DRAFTSIGHT, for warehouse management.

positions.title: Assistant to Sales Associates and Stock Worker
positions.description: Informed and advised customers and clients with purchases and packages. Unloaded and stocked deliveries while maintaining a clean store environment. Prepared and organized purchases for customers and sales associates. Handled merchandise for stocking and shipping processes as well as documented inventory.

positions.title: Quality Engineer Intern
positions.description: Performed quality testing and documentation in compliance with ISO 13485 for medical device manufacturing. Acquired experience with ISO 13485 - 4.2.3 Control of Documents for production routing. Assist Quality Director by producing and organizing digital copies of routing documentation for local network.

positions.title: Club President - Men's Ultimate Frisbee

• Coordinated finances and fundraising for a budget of over $5000 to include dues and sponsorships

projects.title: CS50 Final Project - Bluff City Bout Website
projects.description: This project was submitted to fulfill the final project portion of Harvard's CS50: Intoduction to Computer science. I took the course through edX which is an online course provider and with the support of Tech901 Code 1.0 program. You can find my Github repo for the project here: https://github.com/jtew396/CS50-2018-Final-Project

projects.title: Wireless Instrumented Cane
projects.description:
•	Collaborated with three other students and the Methodist Rehabilitation Center in Jackson, MS from concept to completion
•	Created project plan establishing design criteria, timelines, budget, and deliverables
•	Incorporated a microcontroller, circuit board, and various sensors to monitor and analyze applied forces and orientation
•	Implemented data monitoring system by developing code in C++ for data collection and analysis
•	Procured necessary components for prototype creation and assembly through donations and fund-raising
•	Developed technical documentation including the development process, deliverables, engineering analysis, and results
•	Proposed final design and research findings to faculty, medical professionals, and engineering peers
